pairs.evidence: app/_lib/comms-dispatch.ts:72 Recipient resolution forwards names, opaque identifiers and malformed contacts instead of rejecting unaddressable recipients before transport.

techniques.evidence: app/_lib/comms-view.ts:187 Even an exact messageId match passes through timestamp filtering, so a receipt recorded before its send remains orphaned and the send stays unbounced; a read-only probe confirmed this.
app/_lib/comms-truth.ts:70 A syntactically configured domain and token produce an advertised address without a round-trip verification state.
app/_lib/comms.ts:334 The terminal-failure handler emits console output and a log file, but implements no timed notification to a responsible human.

app/_lib/comms-dispatch.ts:535 Terminal queued outreach returns sent:true and also writes outreach_sent and the outreach send counter, despite no external acceptance.

techniques.evidence: app/_lib/comms-receipt.ts:168 Deferred outcomes enter this non-bounce branch and are discarded, leaving the acceptance standing instead of retaining a soft adverse state until resolution.

app/_lib/comms-resend-outcome.ts:66 Missing and unknown successful-response statuses default to sent; resendOutcome(true, 200, null) was confirmed to return sent.
